before.method_zh: 持票公園場次末30分鐘的超級超夢大型團體戰，獎勵帶當地 GO Fest 地標背景的超夢；另有城市體驗限時調查機會。其他名錄款的逐隻來源仍待核。 城市特殊調查的捷拉奧拉附當地背景；此特殊調查捕捉機會跨城市僅一次。名錄所列其他形態／隊長服裝的逐款條件仍待確認。
before.method_en: Ticketed park Super Mega Raids award city-background Mewtwo; City Experience research adds another chance. Other variants remain under review. after.method_zh: 有效票券時段的指定團體戰有機會獲得地標背景；暗影與一般形態分開列出。公園末30分鐘超級超夢團體戰保證背景。公園特殊調查獎勵捷拉奧拉；隊長服裝款的地標背景與個別取得條件仍未確認，不能套用全球隊伍特殊背景。
after.method_en: Eligible ticketed raids offer a chance of the city background; Shadow and regular forms are distinct. End-of-park Super Mega Raids guarantee background Mewtwo. Park Special Research awards Zeraora. The city-background route for team-leader costumes remains unconfirmed; global team Special Backgrounds are separate.

evolved_pokemon.method_zh: 由相同背景的原始服裝款進化保留；原始款地標背景資格仍待確認。
evolved_pokemon.method_en: Inherited by evolution only if the source costume has this city background; source eligibility remains unconfirmed.

after.date_note_zh: 此期間包含城市體驗限時調查；公園主活動日期另依票券。
after.date_note_en: Range includes City Experience research; park dates follow the ticket.

before.method_zh: 舊金山指定地標現場團體戰與太空裝皮卡丘 GO 集章可得背景；田野調查亦有機會。超夢及其他超級團體戰款的逐隻發放條件仍待核對。 8/30超級超夢X Unity團體戰捕捉的普通超夢保證附城市背景，限現場參與；其他超級團體戰名單仍待逐款確認。
before.method_en: Landmark raids and spacesuit Pikachu stamps award the city background; certain Field Research also offers it. August 30 on-site Mega Mewtwo X Unity Raids award regular Mewtwo with the city background. Other catalog-listed Mega raid variants remain unconfirmed.

pokemon.method_zh: 活動會場團體戰及現場田野調查；田野調查有背景機會，全球直播獎勵不能據此視為保證城市背景。
pokemon.method_en: Event Hall raids and local Field Research; research has a background chance. Global stream rewards alone do not guarantee this city background.

pokemon.method_zh: 科斯莫古太空裝：當地 GO 集章最多6次背景遭遇，另有現場田野調查機會；不是 ESA 太空裝。
pokemon.method_en: Cosmog-themed spacesuit: up to six city Stamp Rally background encounters, plus local Field Research chances; distinct from the ESA astronaut costume.

after.method_zh: 舊金山7個指定地標現場團體戰保證當地背景，每地每日一次；科斯莫古太空裝皮卡丘可由 GO 集章取得，最多6次。現場田野調查的兩款皮卡丘有背景機會。8/30超級超夢X Unity團體戰保證普通超夢城市背景。其他名錄超級團體戰款仍待逐隻核實。
after.method_en: Seven designated San Francisco raid locations guarantee the city background, once daily per location. The Cosmog spacesuit Pikachu Stamp Rally offers up to six encounters; local Pikachu Field Research has a background chance. The August 30 Mega Mewtwo X Unity raid guarantees background Mewtwo. Other catalog-only Mega routes remain unconfirmed.

notes: 延期至10/24–25；原持票者額外特殊調查須在波士頓轉補給站取得背景伊布；特殊調查領取期限至2028/10/23，不可解讀成全球直接發放背景。
before.method_zh: 原持票者領取額外特殊調查，再親自到波士頓轉補給站取得探險帽伊布與背景；沒有波士頓集章活動。
before.method_en: Existing ticket holders obtain supplementary Special Research, then spin PokéStops in Boston for Explorer Hat Eevee with the background. There is no Boston Stamp Rally.

notes: 延期至10/24–25；原持票者額外特殊調查須在波士頓轉補給站取得背景伊布；特殊調查領取期限至2028/10/23，不可解讀成全球直接發放背景。
after.method_zh: 僅限未退款的原持票者：每個持票日各有一份額外特殊調查，每份最多9次探險帽伊布背景遭遇。2026/10/24～2028/10/23可在全球登入領取，但任務須到波士頓轉補給站；沒有波士頓 GO 集章。10/24～25全球野外活動不會直接發放背景伊布。
after.method_en: Existing non-refunded ticket holders receive one supplementary Special Research per ticketed day, with up to nine background Eevee encounters per research. Claim worldwide from October 24, 2026 to October 23, 2028, but spin PokéStops in Boston to progress. No Boston Stamp Rally; the global October 24–25 event does not directly grant background Eevee.
after.date_note_zh: 10/24～25為延期活動日期；特殊調查領取期另至2028/10/23，官方未把該日列為已領取特殊調查的完成期限。
after.date_note_en: October 24–25 is the rescheduled event. October 23, 2028 is the research claim deadline, not an announced completion deadline for already claimed Special Research.

before.method_zh: 親自到訪同一都道府縣的寶可夢人孔蓋補給站，每收集兩枚當地印章，獲得帶該地背景的皮卡丘；好友贈送印章不計入遭遇獎勵。
before.method_en: Collect two in-person Poké Lid stamps in the same prefecture to encounter Pikachu with that prefecture’s background. Gifted stamps do not count toward encounters.
before.verification_note_zh: 背景與適用寶可夢已交叉比對名錄；來源活動日期不一致或不完整，精確日期仍待核對。
before.verification_note_en: The background and eligible Pokémon have been cross-checked. Source dates disagree or are incomplete; exact dates remain under review.
before.date_note_zh: 9/26為素材發現日；非首次發放日。名錄可見皮卡丘，但精確遊戲開放日仍缺官方證據。
before.date_note_en: September 26 is asset detection, not release. Exact first in-game availability remains unconfirmed.

after.method_zh: 親自到訪同一都道府縣的寶可夢人孔蓋補給站，每收集兩枚當地印章，獲得帶該地背景的皮卡丘；好友贈送印章不計入遭遇獎勵。
after.method_en: Collect two in-person Poké Lid stamps in the same prefecture to encounter Pikachu with that prefecture’s background. Gifted stamps do not count toward encounters.
after.verification_note_zh: 10/1開始日由兩份社群來源交叉核對；官方來源支持一般人孔蓋集章規則，並未單獨公告此開始日。
after.verification_note_en: October 1 is cross-checked against two community sources. Official sources support the general rally rules, not this specific rollout date.
after.date_note_zh: 2026/10/1 起實裝。9/26 是素材加入資料的發現日；7/9 是實體人孔蓋公布日，均非遊戲背景發放日。開始日期由兩份非官方來源交叉核對。
after.date_note_en: Available from October 1, 2026, cross-checked against two community sources. September 26 is the asset-discovery date, and July 9 the physical lid announcement, not the in-game release.

before.method_zh: 11/10–14 Into the Wild：指定五星／暗影五星團體戰捕捉暗影洛奇亞、暗影鳳王、四隻卡璞與奈克洛茲瑪時有背景機會。11/15–16全球活動：暗影克雷色利亞、暗影達克萊伊、披風穿著熊及超極巨長毛巨魔由團體戰／極巨對戰機率取得。特殊調查的個別背景保證條件仍待確認。

pokemon.method_en: Chance from wilderness-cape Bewear three-star raids, November 15–16, 2025.

pokemon.method_zh: 2025/11/15～16 六星極巨對戰有機會附背景；特殊調查遭遇長毛巨魔不等於已證實保證背景。
pokemon.method_en: Chance from six-star Max Battles, November 15–16, 2025; the Special Research encounter is not proof of a guaranteed background.

after.method_zh: 11/10–14 Into the Wild：指定五星／暗影五星團體戰捕捉暗影洛奇亞、暗影鳳王、四隻卡璞與奈克洛茲瑪時有背景機會。11/15–16全球活動：暗影克雷色利亞、暗影達克萊伊、披風穿著熊及超極巨長毛巨魔由團體戰／極巨對戰機率取得。特殊調查的個別背景保證條件仍待確認。
after.method_en: Nov 10–14 Into the Wild: eligible five-star/Shadow raids offer background Shadow Lugia, Shadow Ho-Oh, the four Tapu and Necrozma. Nov 15–16 Global: raids/Max Battles offer Shadow Cresselia, Shadow Darkrai, caped Bewear and Gigantamax Grimmsnarl. Individual Special Research guarantees still require confirmation.
